reason: The hypothesis restates the well-known trade-off between configurational entropy and enthalpy that controls phase stability in AlxCoCrFeNi, and the specific role of Al content in driving a transition from single-phase FCC to multiphase structures, as reported in multiple passages (P2, P6, P10, P20, P40). The proposed mechanism linking lattice distortion to a simultaneous improvement in high-temperature strength, environmental resistance, radiation tolerance, and cryogenic toughness is not justified by the cited evidence and merely combines generic HEA property claims (P21, P24, P36) with the known phase stability trend, without a new mechanistic link or synthesis of conflicting findings.
